status: fixed before computing the 13-story individual local-feature outcomes
purpose: extend the complementary individual subject-story analysis to the same complete set of 13 eligible intact narratives used by the central cross-narrative analysis

dataset.story_inclusion: all intact single-run narratives with at least 20 usable participants and at least 5 minutes median duration
dataset.outcome_handling: all 13 stories and all motion-quality-controlled scans are retained regardless of effect direction or significance

primary_analysis.representation: GPT-2 final-layer embeddings computed independently for each 1.5-second TR chunk, with no preceding-story context
primary_analysis.feature_transform: for each evaluated story, fit a story-balanced scaler and five-component PCA to local embeddings from the other 12 stories and project the evaluated story without refitting
primary_analysis.baseline: rich lexical, speech-timing, waveform, spectral, approximate-pitch, and voicing controls
primary_analysis.combined_model: rich baseline plus local GPT-2 PC1-PC5
primary_analysis.neural_model: separate within-scan ridge encoding models for each participant and ROI
primary_analysis.target_preprocessing: linear detrending and standardization estimated separately within each temporal training fold
primary_analysis.predictor_preprocessing: standardization estimated separately within each temporal training fold
primary_analysis.scan_effect: mean combined-minus-baseline change in cross-validated prediction correlation across 17 ROIs
primary_analysis.primary_unit: one mean scan effect per story after averaging participants within story
primary_tests: two-sided one-sample t test across 13 story means
one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test for a positive increment
one-sided exact sign test for a positive increment

prespecified_sensitivities.name: lexical_loso_gap10
prespecified_sensitivities.change_from_primary: use the lexical and linear-time baseline

prespecified_sensitivities.name: rich_loso_gap0
prespecified_sensitivities.change_from_primary: remove the temporal gap to match the earlier eight-story temporal-CV setting

prespecified_sensitivities.name: rich_pooled_gap10
prespecified_sensitivities.change_from_primary: fit one pooled-TR scaler and PCA to local embeddings from all 13 stories, matching the earlier shared-PCA construction while expanding the story set

secondary_inference: intercept-only crossed mixed-effects model of scan effects with participant and story variance components
interpretation_constraints: The primary result will be reported regardless of sign or statistical significance.
No sensitivity analysis will replace the primary specification based on its outcome.
This is a within-story individual-response analysis and does not test transfer of neural coefficients to an unseen narrative.
A nonsignificant result will be described as no reliable incremental effect, not as proof of no effect.
A significant result will be described as an expanded analysis developed before its outcomes were examined, not as an independent prospective replication.
